item.title: The triangle turning area where the refuse Lorries usually park is in terrible disrepair. The road is cracked and damaged and is causing damage to my vehicle as I have to use this junction to get onto my driveway. This is the only access for residents of Parton Court Farm., 9th August
item.description:
At the bottom of Parton Court Farm - behind the bus stop there is a turning area into the farm track. The bin properties etc regularly park here and this bit of road is council owned. The farm track is not. The council owned bit is in horrific disrepair, the concrete has cracked and broken and there are big potholes causing damage to vehicles. A couple of potholes at the entrance were fixed recently but as the others weren’t the ‘fixed’ ones have not fallen back into disrepair. If you were to view the area in question it is apparent that it does need a repair job.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Station Road, Churchdown, Tewkesbury
